name: FlowPath
description: FlowJo-style single-cell analysis for multiplexed tissue imaging in QuPath. Gate cells into named phenotypes with a hierarchical gate tree, then explore them in a UMAP coloured by those same phenotypes.

extensions.name: FlowPath
extensions.description: Interactive tree-based cell phenotyping with hierarchical gates, plus UMAP dimensionality reduction of the resulting phenotypes. Designed for multiplexed imaging data (CODEX, MIBI, mIF).
extensions.author: sceriff0
